fact: Farmerline says its five-year MoU of 12 June 2024 with the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation commits it to develop language and speech models (speech recognition, text-to-speech) for Sierra Leone's agricultural sector, and it claims a first-of-its-kind Krio language model.
EDITH was developed by Sierra Leonean AI specialist Mohamed Alpha for the education ministry with a GBP 50,000 EdTech Hub support package, and is being prepared for handover, not yet released.

Financial Standard reports that mobile operator Africell launched AI-EVA, a multilingual voice assistant for feature phones and smartphones, in Sierra Leone at the 2025 Sierra Leone Innovates Tech Summit.

Financial Standard reports that Africell's AfroGPT, an offline localised language model tailored to Sierra Leonean languages and curricula, was to be piloted in schools and community centres from later in 2025.
